item.title: Historic Chowchilla Stampede travels through town to kick off rodeo season
item.description: It's time to saddle up in the North Valley. The Chowchilla Western Stampede kicked off rodeo season here in the Central Valley with a popular long-standing tradition.

item.title: Over 60 active NFL players attend 'Bring The Juice' Pro-Am in Madera
item.description: Former Fresno State football walk-on turned podcast host Frank Dalena has brought over 60 active NFL players to join his annual "Bring The Juice" golf tournament.

item.title: Registered sex offender Rene Campos fails to get signatures needed for Fresno City Council candidacy
item.description: Registered sex offender Rene Campos failed to reach the required number of signatures to be included on the ballot for the Fresno City Council District 7 race.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE VIDEO: Witnesses run as man opens fire in central Fresno health clinic
item.description: One day after a brazen shooting inside a Family Health Center Clinic in Central Fresno, exclusive video obtained by Action News shows the horror unfolding in real time.

item.title: After a president-filled celebration, Rev. Jesse Jackson's family gathers for a private homegoing
item.description: The private memorial service at the Rainbow PUSH Coalition's headquarters on the South Side of Chicago will include only a few hundred attendees, who are expected to be mostly family members, allies and confidants.

item.title: Crowded race: 10 candidates officially running to be your next governor of California
item.description: Ten major candidates are officially in the running for California governor as of Friday, the filing deadline, marking what political observers say is the most competitive gubernatorial primary the state has seen in years.

item.title: San Joaquin River Parkway Trust complies with Fresno County's cease and desist over human composting
item.description: The San Joaquin River Parkway Trust will no longer use human compost at its 76-acre property in Fresno County. The agreement ending nearly a year's long partnership with Earth Funerals.

item.title: Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in war in the Middle East
item.description: President Donald Trump joined grieving families at Dover Air Force Base for the dignified transfer of six U.S. Army Reserve soldiers killed in Kuwait.

item.title: Oil and gas prices rapidly rise as Iran war shows no signs of letting up
item.description: The price of oil surged higher and showed no signs of halting its rapid climb a week after the U.S. and Israel launched major attacks on Iran that escalated into a war in the Middle East.

item.title: "It breaks my heart": Former coworker speaks about central Fresno clinic shooting victim
item.description: A former employee of the Family Health Care clinic in central Fresno is opening up about the victim who was shot by a patient last Thursday.
